__template__: The main-quest spine: the module's authored throughline as ordered, gated stages. Exactly one stage is live at a time; the story advances only when a stage's exit_condition resolves. This is a directed sandbox, not a rail. Replace every <angle-bracket>, add as many stages as the module's arc needs, and delete the __*__ notes. See ../SPEC_module-charter-generator.md.
__stages__: live_content lists location-group PREFIXES from the scopemap that become surfaceable while this stage is live. The literal token 'villain' resolves to whichever villain-tagged groups the campaign chose. spine_hooks pull toward the NEXT beat (distinct from content hooks, which flesh out the current one). In npcs, the literal '__chosen_villain__' resolves to the chosen villain's name.

stages.title: <Stage title>
stages.objective: <the dramatic goal that defines this stage>
stages.entry_gate: <what makes this stage become live; 'campaign start' for stage 0>
stages.exit_condition: <what resolves this stage and opens the next>
spine_hooks: <a hook that pulls the party toward the next beat>
